heterogeneity_flagged: KEY FINDING — HIGH UNMAPPED SHARE (3 of 5 = 60%). Intelligence is an adversarial, information-integrity domain. Three of its five failure archetypes describe an EXTERNAL DECEIVING ADVERSARY or a CONFIDENTIALITY/INFORMATION-INTEGRITY breach, none of which has an analog among the 9 Part XIV dynamical-failure classes (all E/I archetypes: excitation, inhibition, gating, clearance, synchrony, propagation). This is the same structural gap Finance's FRAUD_SCANDAL exposed, but WIDER: where Finance had 1 of 6 unmapped (17%), Intelligence has 3 of 5 (60%). The taxonomy structurally cannot represent adversarial deception or information-confidentiality failure.

CYBER_ESPIONAGE — UNMAPPED (adversarial network penetration + covert evasion). The failure is not that the system's own inhibition/excitation broke; an external adversary covertly compromised it and evaded detection for months/years. No dynamical archetype expresses an external deceptive adversary. Intelligence's direct analog of Finance FRAUD_SCANDAL.

WHISTLEBLOWER_CRISIS — UNMAPPED (information-integrity / unauthorized disclosure / confidentiality-boundary breach). The modeled event is protected classified information crossing a trust boundary (a leak), which the E/I taxonomy has no archetype for. NEAR-MISS recorded: the CANONICAL node cue vmPFC[Hypo] 'top-down inhibitory brake — brake-fail=rogue' (motif M1) would superficially read as DISINHIBITION_SYNDROME, but that 'brake' framing is itself the force-fit; the authored circuit describes a disclosure/exposure event (oversight bypassed, covert ops exposed, surveillance revealed), not a runaway-excitation dynamic. Marked UNMAPPED per discipline, near-miss flagged.

FOREIGN_INTERFERENCE — UNMAPPED (adversarial disinformation / information contamination). Dominant authored mechanism LANG[Hyper] 'flood domestic information space with propaganda, disinformation, and amplified divisive content' = an adversary INJECTING fabricated hostile content, not a loss of the system's own filter. NEAR-MISS recorded: the word 'flood' and the canonical BNST[Hypo] 'sustained threat monitor — under-vigilant' cue could superficially suggest GATING_FAILURE (flooding) or a hypo-detection, but the flood is fabricated adversary content (information-integrity), which the 9 classes cannot express.

TWO issues that DID map are precisely the two INTERNAL dynamical-regulation failures (own detector/integrator failed; own oversight brake failed) — a clean thematic split: Intelligence's failures partition into internal-regulation failures (mappable) and adversarial/information-integrity failures (unmappable).

MASS_SURVEILLANCE_SCANDAL and WHISTLEBLOWER_CRISIS — their _authored circuits FAIL the incomplete-circuit test (no node from the doc's canonical REGULATORY_NODES set is present). Both circuits DO contain the oversight node rACC, which is conceptually a regulatory/fairness-monitor arm, but rACC is NOT on energy-neuro-substrate.js's fixed REGULATORY_NODES list, so the mechanical test scores them INCOMPLETE. Observation recorded per issue; this is a divergence from Finance (6/6 complete).
_meta.honesty_note: Mechanisms, failure-mode classes, parameters, and references below are verbatim-grounded in the source document. Per-node / per-edge Intelligence-specific assignments the document gives no basis for (which edge is which inhibitory motif, which oscillatory band, which neuromodulator, which predictive direction) are NOT guessed here; only the two operations the source document directly supports are performed: (1) classify each authored issue against the Part XIV failure taxonomy where the issue's own text names a matching dynamical mechanism, else mark UNMAPPED, and (2) run the Part XIV incomplete-circuit test.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Excitation/inhibition (E/I) balance
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Inhibition tracks excitation on a millisecond timescale; balance sets gain, dynamic range, timing precision, and stability. Loss of inhibition -> runaway (seizure); excess -> silence.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Any faithful mapping must have inhibition/brakes that SCALE WITH DRIVE.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Four inhibitory motifs
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: feedforward (narrow temporal window / coincidence), feedback/recurrent (self-limiting, gain control, stability), lateral (contrast enhancement, winner-take-all, sparsening), disinhibition (inhibiting an inhibitor = permissive gating/selection).
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: All four are reused at every scale; their absence breaks the fractal.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Oscillations & communication-through-coherence
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Rhythms create periodic windows of excitability; groups that oscillate coherently open input/output windows at the same time and communicate; incoherent groups are functionally disconnected. Bands: delta 1-4, theta 4-8, alpha 8-12, beta 13-30, gamma 30-80+ Hz.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Coherence = a dynamic routing/connection switch. There is an OPTIMAL coupling band; too-strong and too-weak coupling both fail.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Thalamocortical gating
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Thalamus + TRN gate what reaches cortex; tonic (faithful relay) vs burst (detection/alerting) modes under corticothalamic top-down control.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Gating must occur AT THE RIGHT STAGE - filter too early (before the circuit that needs the signal) and you lose information you cannot recover.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Predictive coding / prediction error
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Hierarchical generative machine: top-down predictions descend, bottom-up prediction ERRORS ascend, only the mismatch propagates upward. Laminar correlate: forward = error, backward = prediction.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: 'Prediction error drives update' must also GENERATE predictions at the mapped scale, not merely react.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Plasticity / learning rules
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Hebbian (correlated -> strengthen); STDP (pre-before-post ~+10 ms -> LTP, post-before-pre -> LTD; dopamine extends LTP window to ~+30 ms); LTP/LTD (NMDA/Ca2+); homeostatic scaling (global normalization keeping drive in range so Hebbian learning does not run away); metaplasticity (threshold for change adapts).
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A stabilizing counter-process (homeostatic scaling) MUST counter positive-feedback Hebbian learning, or the system runs away.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Neuromodulation & gain
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Diffuse systems (DA, NE, 5-HT, ACh) carry no detailed content; they set global regime - gain, signal-to-noise, exploration/exploitation, learning rate, arousal. A small modulatory signal reconfigures the whole network's operating point.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A small broadcast signal must be able to rescale the whole system's operating point (one-to-many, multiplicative).

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Population & attractor dynamics
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Information lives in distributed population activity, not single cells; sparse coding is efficient/separable; attractor dynamics implement stable states and transitions. Over-gating, over-synchrony, or lost inhibition suppress emergence.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Emergence requires distributed, sparse, inhibition-balanced activity; do not concentrate all state in one node.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Sleep, homeostasis & offline processing
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Sleep down-scales synapses globally while consolidating select memories, and drives glymphatic clearance of waste.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A mandatory OFFLINE maintenance/reset phase - a system with no downtime accumulates damage.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Signal termination / clearance
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Reuptake, enzymatic degradation, and diffusion bound signal persistence; termination is as important as release and prevents excitotoxic accumulation.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Clearance/termination must bound signal persistence; a signal that isn't cleared becomes toxic (see failure mode EXCITOTOXICITY).

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Refractoriness / dead-time rate limiter
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Absolute refractory period (~1-2 ms) after an action prevents a second action; enforces one-way propagation and caps maximum firing rate.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A built-in rate limiter / dead-time after action must exist to cap throughput and enforce directionality.

inhibitory_motifs_catalog.definition: Input excites both a target and an interneuron that inhibits the target -> narrow temporal window (coincidence-detection, AND within a time window).
Output feeds back through interneurons -> self-limiting, gain control, stability.
Active units suppress neighbors -> contrast enhancement, winner-take-all, sparsening.
Inhibiting an inhibitor -> permissive gating / selection.

failure_modes.definition: E/I balance failure: runaway recurrent excitation when inhibition is insufficient. Archetypal no-brakes -> runaway.
Excessive drive with failed termination/clearance -> overload -> death of the unit.
A slow wave of depolarization then silence; homeostatic overwhelm.
Thalamocortical/TRN gating breakdown: too little filtering -> flooding, or mis-timed gating -> wrong information passed; gate stuck closed -> starvation.
Losing the inhibitor releases pathological activity (loss of the stop/brake).
Over-coupling (hypersynchrony) or under-coupling; both degrade communication.
Aggregation + failed clearance + network collapse; maintenance failure compounding over time.
Losing input disables not just the lesioned node but distant connected regions. THE NETWORK, NOT THE NODE, IS THE UNIT OF FAILURE; failures propagate across the graph.

A circuit built without its regulatory partner is intrinsically dysfunctional (fear acquisition without extinction; excitation without matched inhibition; feedback without the sensor). THE DIRECT DIAGNOSTIC FOR A BROKEN FRACTAL MAPPING: if the mapping omits the inhibitory/feedback/extinction arm, it is lesioned in the same way a brain is.

INTELLIGENCE_FAILURE.subtype: mis-staged / stuck gating -> information collected but not integrated (starvation of the decision node)
INTELLIGENCE_FAILURE.intel_text: circuit CLAUST[Hypo]: "Intelligence fusion failure — agencies collected relevant pieces of the puzzle but institutional barriers prevented integration into a coherent threat picture until after the event"; circuit dACC[Hypo]: "Threat assessment monitoring failed to detect deviation from expected adversary behavior"; summary: "collection gaps, analytical bias, stovepiping between agencies"
INTELLIGENCE_FAILURE.reasoning: The dominant named mechanism is an INTERNAL detection/integration failure: the relevant signal was collected but the binding/routing hub (CLAUST fusion) and the conflict monitor (dACC) failed to pass it to the decision stage before the event. This is the THALAMOCORTICAL_GATING invariant violated exactly as the doc states it: 'filter too early (before the circuit that needs the signal) and you lose information you cannot recover.' Information collected but not integrated = GATING_FAILURE (mis-staged gating / gate stuck -> starvation of the downstream integrator).
INTELLIGENCE_FAILURE.note: MAPPABLE because the failure is the OWN system's hypofunction (fusion failure, failed detection, failed prediction, overwhelmed analytics), NOT an external adversary injecting false content. The circuit is all Hypo/Altered (under-function). Secondary flavor: PRECUNEUS[Hypo] 'mirror-imaging' is a PREDICTIVE_CODING model failure, for which there is no dedicated dynamical class; classed on the dominant fusion/detection gating cue.

MASS_SURVEILLANCE_SCANDAL.subtype: brake-fail -> runaway (loss of the stop/oversight arm)
MASS_SURVEILLANCE_SCANDAL.intel_text: canonical circuit vlPFC[Hypo]: "response-inhibition / stop — disinhibited"; _authored DAN[Hyper]: "Surveillance systems expanded from targeted monitoring... to bulk collection of entire populations, with technical capability outpacing legal and ethical constraints"; _authored rACC[Hypo]: "Intelligence oversight mechanisms failed to constrain or even detect the scope of bulk collection"
MASS_SURVEILLANCE_SCANDAL.reasoning: The canonical cue literally names the mechanism: vlPFC[Hypo] 'response-inhibition / stop — disinhibited' (motif M1, loss of the stop). The _authored circuit confirms it: the inhibitory/oversight arm (rACC oversight) failed to constrain while collection (DAN) ran away 'outpacing constraints.' Losing the inhibitor and releasing pathological over-activity is the exact DISINHIBITION_SYNDROME definition (loss of the stop/brake). Strongest grounding of the set.
MASS_SURVEILLANCE_SCANDAL.note: MAPPABLE because this is an INTERNAL dynamical failure — the system's OWN brake (oversight) failed and its OWN activity (surveillance) ran away. Mirrors Finance CURRENCY_COLLAPSE 'brake-fail=rogue' -> DISINHIBITION; here the canonical cue names the disinhibited stop directly.

CYBER_ESPIONAGE.reason: Adversarial network penetration + covert evasion. No analog among the 9 Part XIV dynamical classes.
CYBER_ESPIONAGE.intel_text: canonical circuit BLA[Hypo]: "threat learning/acquisition — fearless"; _authored FPN[Altered]: "Cyber defense networks compromised as adversary achieved persistent access through supply chain attacks, zero-day exploits"; _authored BLA[Hypo]: "Counterintelligence detection failed to identify network penetration, with adversary maintaining persistent access for months or years before discovery"; summary: "State-sponsored penetration... to steal classified data... establish persistent access"
CYBER_ESPIONAGE.reasoning: The failure is not that the system's own inhibition/excitation broke; an EXTERNAL ADVERSARY covertly penetrated the network, deliberately evaded detection, and maintained persistent access. The 9 Part XIV classes are all dynamical-failure archetypes (excitation, inhibition, gating, clearance, synchrony, propagation); none expresses an external deceptive adversary or covert compromise. Forcing it into GATING_FAILURE (on the 'detection failed' cue) would misread an adversarial intrusion as a passive filter fault. Marked UNMAPPED per discipline.
CYBER_ESPIONAGE.note: Intelligence's direct analog of Finance FRAUD_SCANDAL. The taxonomy structurally cannot represent adversarial deception.

WHISTLEBLOWER_CRISIS.reason: Information-integrity / unauthorized disclosure / confidentiality-boundary breach. No analog among the 9 dynamical classes.
WHISTLEBLOWER_CRISIS.intel_text: canonical circuit vmPFC[Hypo]: "top-down inhibitory brake — brake-fail=rogue" (motif M1); _authored rACC[Altered]: "whistleblower concluded internal channels were inadequate... bypassing institutional oversight to reach the public directly"; _authored PAG[Altered]: "Covert operations exposed to public scrutiny"; summary: "Unauthorized disclosure of classified intelligence programs to the press or public"
WHISTLEBLOWER_CRISIS.reasoning: The modeled event is protected classified information crossing a trust boundary (a leak / disclosure). The E/I taxonomy has no archetype for a confidentiality / information-integrity breach — its failures are all about signal DYNAMICS, not about protected content escaping a boundary. NEAR-MISS: the canonical vmPFC 'brake-fail=rogue' cue would superficially read as DISINHIBITION_SYNDROME (an insider 'going rogue' = loss of a containing brake), but a single deliberate disclosure act is not runaway excitation; the 'brake' framing is itself the force-fit. The authored circuit describes disclosure/exposure consequences (oversight bypassed, covert ops exposed, surveillance revealed), not a damping-capacity dynamic. Marked UNMAPPED, near-miss flagged.
WHISTLEBLOWER_CRISIS.note: Judgment call recorded transparently: a defensible DISINHIBITION reading exists on the canonical cue, but the ACTUAL event modeled (a classified leak) is information-integrity, which the task discipline routes to UNMAPPED.

FOREIGN_INTERFERENCE.reason: Adversarial disinformation / information contamination (adversary injecting fabricated hostile content). No analog among the 9 dynamical classes.
FOREIGN_INTERFERENCE.intel_text: canonical circuit BNST[Hypo]: "sustained threat monitor — under-vigilant" (motif M7); _authored LANG[Hyper]: "Information warfare operations flood domestic information space with propaganda, disinformation, and amplified divisive content designed to polarize and paralyze democratic discourse"; _authored BLA[Hypo]: "Counterintelligence fails to detect covert foreign influence operations"; summary: "Systematic foreign government effort to manipulate domestic political processes, public opinion"
FOREIGN_INTERFERENCE.reasoning: The dominant authored mechanism is an adversary INJECTING fabricated hostile content into the information space, not a loss of the system's own filter. NEAR-MISS: the word 'flood' (LANG[Hyper]) and the canonical BNST 'under-vigilant' cue could superficially suggest GATING_FAILURE (flooding) or a hypo-detection, but the flood is DELIBERATELY FABRICATED adversary content (an information-integrity / deception failure), which the 9 dynamical classes cannot express. Classing it GATING_FAILURE would erase the adversarial-content dimension. Marked UNMAPPED, near-miss flagged.
FOREIGN_INTERFERENCE.note: Second adversarial/information-integrity UNMAPPED (with CYBER_ESPIONAGE). Together with the WHISTLEBLOWER confidentiality breach, these three are exactly the failures involving an external adversary or a content/confidentiality integrity boundary.

incomplete_circuit_diagnostic._test: Part XIV: does each issue's authored circuit contain a regulatory/inhibitory/feedback partner from the REGULATORY_NODES set in energy-neuro-substrate.js (vmPFC, dlPFC, OFC, STN, GP, HIPP, HYPO, dACC, CBLM)? Run against intelligence.json via validateIncompleteCircuit() (uses issue._authored || issue.circuits).
incomplete_circuit_diagnostic._verdict_summary: 3 complete / 2 INCOMPLETE (of 5). DIVERGES from Finance (6/6 complete). The two INCOMPLETE circuits (MASS_SURVEILLANCE_SCANDAL, WHISTLEBLOWER_CRISIS) contain NO node from the fixed REGULATORY_NODES list. Both DO contain rACC (Intelligence Oversight — a conceptual regulatory/fairness-monitor arm), but rACC is not on the doc's canonical REGULATORY_NODES list, so the mechanical test scores them INCOMPLETE. This is an artifact worth flagging: the regulatory arm is present in substance (oversight) but not in the exact node vocabulary the diagnostic checks.

MASS_SURVEILLANCE_SCANDAL.observation: No REGULATORY_NODES member present. rACC (oversight) IS the conceptual inhibitory/fairness arm and IS in the circuit, but rACC is absent from the fixed REGULATORY_NODES list, so the test fires INCOMPLETE. Note the failure-class map still classes this issue DISINHIBITION_SYNDROME (its brake FAILED) — a circuit can be scored INCOMPLETE by the fixed-list test AND be a genuine disinhibition failure; consistent, since a disinhibition failure IS a missing/failed brake.

CYBER_ESPIONAGE.observation: Circuit is structurally complete (dACC monitor + dlPFC executive present), yet the issue is UNMAPPED in the failure-class map: a circuit can pass the incomplete-circuit test and still express a failure archetype (adversarial penetration) outside the 9-class taxonomy. The two diagnostics are independent.

WHISTLEBLOWER_CRISIS.observation: No REGULATORY_NODES member present. rACC (oversight) is in the circuit but not on the fixed list. The canonical single-node circuit for this issue is vmPFC[Hypo] (motif M1, and vmPFC IS a REGULATORY_NODES member) — so had the diagnostic run on the CANONICAL circuit instead of _authored, this issue would score complete. The _authored expansion, which the test prefers, drops vmPFC and scores INCOMPLETE.

FOREIGN_INTERFERENCE.observation: Structurally complete, but UNMAPPED in the failure-class map (adversarial disinformation). Independent diagnostics, same pattern as CYBER_ESPIONAGE.

parameter_table.ratio_preservation_rule: When mapping any neural time constant to a domain equivalent, hold the RATIOS between constants fixed, not just individual values. The ~1000x gap between AP duration (~1 ms) and slow neuromodulatory/hormonal feedback (~seconds-minutes) is the 'fast signal vs slow modulation' invariant; the Intelligence mapping must preserve an analogous fast-collection / slow-governance separation (raw intercept vs oversight/analytic-tradecraft loop), or the fractal is cosmetic, not structural.
